body:
# HomiesHouse Cobblemon Pack

Welcome to the **HomiesHouse Cobblemon Pack**, a custom-built Pokémon adventure crafted by Wubbity and the HomiesHouse team! Designed for our vibrant community at [HomiesHouse.net](https://homieshouse.net), this pack takes the beloved **Cobblemon** mod and amps it up with Mega Evolutions, rare Pokémon, and exclusive features. Whether you’re a Pokémon trainer at heart or a Minecraft explorer seeking something new, this pack is your gateway to an epic journey.

## What’s Inside?

We’ve blended the best of Cobblemon with carefully selected addons to create a unique experience. Here’s what you’ll find:

- **Cobblemon (Core Mod)** - Catch, battle, and trade Pokémon in a beautifully integrated Minecraft world. From Pikachu to Garchomp, your favorites are here!
- **Cobblemon Mega Showdown** - Unleash the power of Mega Evolutions! Find Mega Stones, craft Mega Bracelets, and evolve your Pokémon into their ultimate forms during epic battles.
- **GenoMons Datapack** - Discover over 40 new Pokémon, including Galarian Legendary Birds, Bloodmoon Ursaluna, and more rare variants not found in vanilla Cobblemon.
- **MissingMons Datapack** - Expand your Pokédex with community-voted additions like Shaymin, Marill, Rockruff, and the elusive Ogerpon. (Requires the included resource pack!)
- **Cobblemon Armors** - Gear up with Pokémon-themed armor sets, perfect for showing off your trainer style.
- **Cobblemon Drop Loot Tables** - Find Pokémon-related loot as you explore, adding exciting rewards to your journey.
- **Cobblemon Fight or Flight Fabric** - Experience enhanced battle mechanics for more thrilling Pokémon showdowns.
- **Cobblemon Riding Fabric** - Ride your Pokémon across the world, from Charizard to Lapras!
- **Cobblemon Shearms** - Shear certain Pokémon like Wooloo for unique resources and interactions.
- **Dynamic FPS** - Boost performance by reducing resource usage when idle, ensuring a smoother experience.
- **EnchantmentDescriptions** - See detailed enchantment info in-game, making gear upgrades easier.
- **Enhanced Attack Indicator** - Get better combat feedback, perfect for Pokémon battles.
- **Xaero’s Minimap** - Navigate with a sleek minimap, making exploration a breeze.
- **SwingThrough Comprehensive Cobblemon Edits of Destiny** - Seamlessly swing through grass and obstacles during battles, tailored for Cobblemon.

## Why Play HomiesHouse Cobblemon?

This isn’t just a modpack—it’s an invitation to join our six-server network at HomiesHouse, where community and creativity thrive. Here’s what sets us apart:

- **Customized Experience** - We’ve fine-tuned these mods and datapacks for compatibility and fun, ensuring a smooth and balanced adventure.
- **Active Community** - Join trainers from around the world on our Cobblemon server, trade Pokémon, and battle in style.
- **Regular Updates** - Wubbity and the team are committed to keeping this pack fresh with new features and fixes.

## Installation Guide

Getting started is easy! Follow these steps to join the fun:

1. **Download the Pack** - Grab the latest version from this CurseForge page.
2. **Install Fabric** - This pack requires Fabric Loader and Fabric API for Minecraft [insert version, e.g., 1.20.1]. Check the dependencies section below!
3. **Add the Resource Pack** - For MissingMons Pokémon to look their best, enable the included *MissingMons Resource Pack* in your Minecraft resource pack menu.
4. **Join the Server** - Launch the pack, hop into multiplayer, and connect to [insert server IP, e.g., cobblemon.homieshouse.net].

*Note:* Single-player worlds work too! Just create a new world, and you’re ready to catch ‘em all.

## Dependencies

This pack relies on the following:

- [Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api) - Essential for Fabric mods.
- [Cobblemon](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cobblemon) - The heart of the Pokémon experience.
- [Cobblemon Mega Showdown](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cobblemon-mega-showdown) - Mega Evolution mechanics.

The **GenoMons** and **MissingMons** datapacks are bundled in the pack—no extra downloads needed!

## Join the HomiesHouse Community

Ready to dive in? Visit us at [HomiesHouse.net](https://homieshouse.net) to explore all six of our Minecraft servers, from survival to minigames. Follow us on [insert social media, e.g., Twitter/Discord] for updates, events, and more!

**Questions or Issues?** Drop a comment below or reach out on our Discord. Wubbity and the HomiesHouse crew are here to help!

## Credits

A huge thanks to the creators who made this possible:

- **Cobblemon Team** - For the incredible base mod.
- **Mega Showdown Devs** - For bringing Mega Evolutions to life.
- **GenoMons & MissingMons Creators** - For expanding the Pokémon roster.

Now grab your Poké Balls and start your adventure with the HomiesHouse Cobblemon Pack!
